answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 6439 Country: India Title: Is the current system of receiving subsidy from the Government of India for performing Hajj valid? Question: Is the current system of receiving subsidy from the Government of India for performing Hajj valid? Answer ID: 6439 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 595/595=M-1429) It is allowed to receive the subsidy; it is a special concession from the government to those going to perform Hajj through Hajj Committee, so there is no wrong to receive it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
